name: accessanalyzer
description: Identity and Access Management Access Analyzer helps you to set, verify, and refine your IAM policies by providing a suite of capabilities.

subcommands.name: apply-archive-rule
subcommands.description: Retroactively applies the archive rule to existing findings that meet the archive rule criteria.

subcommands.name: cancel-policy-generation
subcommands.description: Cancels the requested policy generation.

subcommands.name: check-access-not-granted
subcommands.description: Checks whether the specified access isn't allowed by a policy.

subcommands.name: check-no-new-access
subcommands.description: Checks whether new access is allowed for an updated policy when compared to the existing policy.

subcommands.name: check-no-public-access
subcommands.description: Checks whether a resource policy can grant public access to the specified resource type.

subcommands.name: create-access-preview
subcommands.description: Creates an access preview that allows you to preview IAM Access Analyzer findings for your resource before deploying resource permissions.

subcommands.name: create-analyzer
subcommands.description: Creates an analyzer for your account.

subcommands.name: create-archive-rule
subcommands.description: Creates an archive rule for the specified analyzer.

subcommands.name: create-service-linked-analyzer
subcommands.description: Creates a service-linked analyzer managed by an Amazon Web Services service.

subcommands.name: delete-analyzer
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified analyzer.

subcommands.name: delete-archive-rule
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified archive rule.

subcommands.name: delete-service-linked-analyzer
subcommands.description: Deletes a service-linked analyzer.

subcommands.name: generate-finding-recommendation
subcommands.description: Creates a recommendation for an unused permissions finding.

subcommands.name: get-access-preview
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about an access preview for the specified analyzer.

subcommands.name: get-analyzed-resource
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a resource that was analyzed.

subcommands.name: get-analyzer
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the specified analyzer.

subcommands.name: get-archive-rule
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about an archive rule.

subcommands.name: get-finding
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the specified finding.

subcommands.name: get-finding-recommendation
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a finding recommendation for the specified analyzer.

subcommands.name: get-finding-v2
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the specified finding.

subcommands.name: get-findings-statistics
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of aggregated finding statistics for an external access or unused access analyzer.

subcommands.name: get-generated-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves the policy that was generated using StartPolicyGeneration.

subcommands.name: list-access-preview-findings
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of access preview findings generated by the specified access preview.

subcommands.name: list-access-previews
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of access previews for the specified analyzer.

subcommands.name: list-analyzed-resources
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of resources of the specified type that have been analyzed by the specified analyzer.

subcommands.name: list-analyzers
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of analyzers.

subcommands.name: list-archive-rules
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of archive rules created for the specified analyzer.

subcommands.name: list-findings
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of findings generated by the specified analyzer.

subcommands.name: list-findings-v2
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of findings generated by the specified analyzer.

subcommands.name: list-policy-generations
subcommands.description: Lists all of the policy generations requested in the last seven days.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of tags applied to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: start-policy-generation
subcommands.description: Starts the policy generation request.

subcommands.name: start-resource-scan
subcommands.description: Immediately starts a scan of the policies applied to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds a tag to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes a tag from the specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-analyzer
subcommands.description: Modifies the configuration of an existing analyzer.

subcommands.name: update-archive-rule
subcommands.description: Updates the criteria and values for the specified archive rule.

subcommands.name: update-findings
subcommands.description: Updates the status for the specified findings.

subcommands.name: validate-policy
subcommands.description: Requests the validation of a policy and returns a list of findings.
